cards.name: Dark Electrode
cards.description: Some researchers hypothesize that Electrode may actually be a form of energy instead of having an actual body.

cards.name: Dark Flareon

cards.name: Dark Golduck
cards.description: When Psyducks evolve, their headaches disappear and they find themselves in possession of formidable mental powers.

cards.name: Dark Jolteon
cards.description: A dangerous Pokémon when angered. It likes to playfully shock people with the electricity it stores within its body.

cards.name: Dark Kadabra

cards.name: Dark Charizard

cards.name: Dark Machoke
cards.description: While normally peaceful and friendly, the number of incidents involving cruel Machokes is rising.

cards.name: Dark Muk
cards.description: Muks appear suddenly, spreading sludge everywhere. Whenever one appears in a city, panic ensues.

cards.name: Dark Persian
cards.description: Popular with women because of its beautiful fur. The leader of the Rockets keeps one as a pet.

cards.name: Dark Primeape
cards.description: Although Primeapes have always been mean, lately they seem to be becoming even more vicious and frenzied.

cards.name: Dark Rapidash
cards.description: A wild, uncontrollable Pokémon. When running, it looks like a comet streaking through the sky.

cards.name: Dark Vaporeon
cards.description: A Pokémon capable of controlling water, so it is capable of creating giant whirlpools.

cards.name: Dark Wartortle
cards.description: A Pokémon with a negative attitude, it hides in its shell whenever it's in a bad mood—which is often.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.description: Recent research has revealed the presence of dragon DNA in this species of Pokémon.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.description: More and more people play the slots every day, trying to win a Porygon.

cards.name: Abra
cards.description: It teleports itself away from danger, making it difficult to capture.

cards.name: Dark Dragonite
cards.description: Sometimes called "The God of Destruction." Its wings are able to support it in spite of its massive weight.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.description: Many people find it cute and try to hold it, only to be burned by its tail.

cards.name: Dark Raticate
cards.description: A Raticate's front teeth are incredibly powerful; it can destroy a two-story house with them in 5 minutes.

cards.name: Diglett
cards.description: It follows Onixes in their tunnels, looking for scraps of food they have left behind.

cards.name: Dratini
cards.description: The capture of the first Dratini inspired the search for other legendary Pokémon.

cards.name: Drowzee
cards.description: Not popular with girls because of its attitude. Can often be heard muttering to itself in a low voice.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: A rare and unique Pokémon about which little is known, as few have been captured.

cards.name: Ekans
cards.description: A carnivore that swallows its prey whole. Pidgeys and Spearows are its favorite food.

cards.name: Grimer
cards.description: It has recently been found that Grimers are formed in waste-processing plants, and can move into towns via sewers.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.description: First discovered in a weapons factory, this Pokémon can now be found almost anywhere.

cards.name: Machop
cards.description: It's said that not even pro wrestlers can take down a Machop.

cards.name: Dark Dugtrio
cards.description: Digs large sinkholes in the ground and tries to trap its enemies in them.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.description: It is said that enough Magnemites and Magnetons gather in one place, they can create a powerful magnetic barrier.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.description: Normally friendly, it quickly becomes angry if it doesn't get what it wants.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.description: A popular Pokémon that earns money for its owner with its "Pay Day" ability.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.description: It wanders around at night sowing its seeds to create more Oddishes.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.description: A gentle grass-eater, it will allow riders on its back. However, anyone attempting to do so must be careful not to get burned.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.description: It is often seen holding its head in its paws, as if it were suffering from a headache.

cards.name: Rattata
cards.description: Loves to eat walnuts, chestnuts, cheese, and milk.

cards.name: Slowpoke
cards.description: Although it knows how to fish, no other intelligent behavior has been detected in it.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.description: Cute Pokémon that charms people with its innocent eyes. Loves swimming all day long.

cards.name: Voltorb
cards.description: Usually seen only in power plants, it is sometimes seen in towns, apparently using the power lines to travel.
